author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Glossed eyes
Will gone
Staring into the next

Without looking at all

Shaken stance

But standing strong.

I only see love in those hollowed
looks

It's time. Wish for more
But I can see.
Clearly through tears
Our goodbye.
Rest well
Close those tired eyes
For you will always help me
